v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Commune aut Festo

text.la: Ego plantávi, * Apóllo rigávit, Deus autem increméntum dedit.
text.en: I have planted, * Apollos watered, but God gave the increase.

text.la: Libénter gloriábor * in infirmitátibus meis, ut inhábitet in me virtus Christi.
text.en: Most gladly therefore will I rather glory * in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.

text.la: Grátia Dei * in me vácua non fuit, sed grátia eius semper in me manet.
text.en: The grace of God which was bestowed upon me was not in vain, * but His grace abideth ever in me.

text.la: Damásci, præpósitus * gentis Arétæ regis vóluit me comprehéndere: a frátribus per murum demíssus sum in sporta, et sic evási manus eius in nómine Dómini.
text.en: In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king was desirous to apprehend me; by the brethren in a basket was I let down by the wall, and so escaped I his hands, in the name of the Lord.

text.la: Ter virgis cæsus sum, * semel lapidátus sum, ter naufrágium pértuli pro Christi nómine.
text.en: Thrice was I beaten with rods, * once was I stoned, thrice I suffered shipwreck, for Christ's name's sake.

text.la: Saulus autem adhuc spirans minárum et cædis in discípulos Dómini, accéssit ad príncipem sacerdótum, et pétiit ab eo epístolas in Damáscum ad synagógas: ut si quos invenísset huius viæ viros ac mulíeres, vinctos perdúceret in Ierúsalem.
text.en: And Saul, as yet breathing out threatenings and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest, and asked of him letters to Damascus, to the synagogues: that if he found any men and women of this way, he might bring them bound to Jerusalem.

v.en: They declared the works of God.

text.la: Sancte Paule Apóstole, * prædicátor veritátis et doctor géntium, intercéde pro nobis ad Deum, qui te elégit.
text.en: O Holy Apostle Paul, * Preacher of the truth, and Teacher of the Gentiles, pray for us to God Who hath chosen thee.

text.la: Deus, qui univérsum mundum beáti Pauli Apóstoli prædicatióne docuísti: da nobis, quǽsumus; ut, qui eius hódie Conversiónem cólimus, per eius ad te exémpla gradiámur.
text.en: O God, Who, through the teaching of the Blessed Apostle Paul, hast caused the light of the Gospel to shine throughout the world, grant, we beseech thee, that we, having his wonderful conversion as on this day in remembrance, may show forth our thankfulness unto thee for the same, by following the holy example which he hath set.
